USER TURN 6
k, what chagnes hve to be made, lets make a quick dock for spec then make the chagnes

cache/gateway-effective ?  tahts a better name

ASSISTANT TURN 6 (2 messages, last privileged)
[earlier] I’m treating `cache/gateway-effective` as a naming proposal before we lock the spec. I’ll test it against the actual ownership: generated effective configuration is per zone and is live runtime input, so the name needs to preserve both facts.
[last] `gateway-effective` is a much better name for the content, but it should not live in the shared cache.

Recommended:

```text
~/.agent-vm/
│
├── cache/
│   └── vm-images/
│       └── <fingerprint>/                 shared generated images
│
└── <deployment>/
    └── <zone>/
        └── runtime/
            └── gateway-effective/
                ├── tool-portal.config.jsonc
                ├── mcp.config.jsonc
                ├── mcp-portal.config.jsonc
                ├── gateway-runtime-portal-admission.json
                └── manifest.json
```

Why `runtime/gateway-effective`, not `cache/gateway-effective`:

```text
gateway-effective
  deployment-specific
  zone-specific
  generated from authored configuration
  actively consumed while the Gateway runs
  recreated during preflight/startup
  not reusable across deployments
```

Then the complete separation becomes:

```text
cache/vm-images/                     shared content-addressed artifacts

<deployment>/<zone>/runtime/
  gateway-effective/                 generated live configuration
  logs/                              runtime evidence
  control-sessions/                  runtime control material

<deployment>/<zone>/state/           durable application data
<deployment>/<zone>/zone-files/      durable user/agent files
```

If we want the smallest possible rename without correcting ownership, this would be acceptable:

```text
<deployment>/cache/gateway-effective/<zone>/
```

But my recommendation for the spec is:

```text
<deployment>/<zone>/runtime/gateway-effective/
```

It states the truth directly: one zone’s generated effective Gateway configuration, used at runtime.
